name: Palau
headline: Palau: +6.0% growth in 2025, 0.2% inflation, debt 53% of GDP
sections: Palau is a $352 million economy (2025), the world's 211th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +6.0% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $23K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 1.2% of GDP (2024).
Consumer prices rose 0.2% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 13.2% in 2022.
Gross government debt is 53% of GDP (2025), a moderate level. The general government balance is −0.4% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −11.6% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need. Trade equals 106% of GDP (2024), a highly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 16.6% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 41% of GDP by 2031, on a declining path from today's level. Life expectancy is 69.4 years (2024). Population: 18 thousand (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
